beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The Cascade of the New asks what powerful worlds owe their sources of novelty.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its speculative case begins with Sera losing a cherished possibility at home.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A larger system values the difference between prediction and a conscious choice.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book makes that appetite collide with the lives producing what surprises it.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its invented dimensions alter what a person can remember, choose, and keep.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: That makes an unfamiliar cosmology tangible through loss, rather than decorative complexity.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Sera inhabits a room whose stability includes more than one possible history.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A cherished Sunday memory cannot remain supported alongside another valued possibility.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The loss introduces a world where continuities depend on managed resources.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Descending into fewer dimensions then makes freedom a bodily and institutional problem.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Possibilities that once remained available become decisions that cannot simply be revised.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The novel gives its conceptual vocabulary consequences before asking readers to generalize.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The investigation reaches worlds that produce differences valuable to more powerful observers.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A surprising choice is not merely another item in an archive.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Someone must live through the constraints that make that choice matter.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The case-file structure brings personal testimony into conflict with systems of valuation.
